notes.title: WEEB Major Update #1
notes.notes:
You can now progress your clicks in the form of click power and Hearts per second. Upgrade your clicks, find unlockable skins and find more Waifus!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/3327449b1e211ed6a7dadd264713b0bdbbe48130.jpg


 Update Summary
 Added more unlockable skins!
 Click progression.
 Updates to clicks.
 Automated "Hearts per second" upgrades.
 Secret unlockable skins.
 More places to visit.

We are thinking about expanding the inventory system where each Waifu will have defined stats to click powers. Stay tuned for more information about that in the near future!

notes.title: Waifuween is here! New drop pool changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/d7e540142a8cdb662a7668314e3abe1f38eb03e3.png

With Waifuween, changes have been done to the Waifu drop pool!

New drop pool changes are here just in time for the spooky season! The new waifus can be just as cute as they are scary. There are 4 new and unique waifus waiting to join your party. Maybe you can show them the spirit of Waifuween?

notes.title: Drop Pool Changes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/0a42b329fc1f9350b3e5fc18d4f7cc746240ee46.png

Changes have been done to the Waifu drop pool!

New drop pool changes towards the fall season will include many new Waifus. Keep an eye out for the legendary Elementalist Waifu! 

We have more planned as we are moving towards the spooky season.

notes.title: New Waifu Drop Pool Changes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/695cd0c1e128ea12052a6352eeed75b2c89d581b.png

Medieval Waifu Tournament is Over!

The Medieval Waifu Tournament Event has now concluded! With that comes new changes to Waifu Drop pool. There are 4 new Waifu's that are waiting to join the journey!

We have planned new features towards WEEB soon, and can't wait to show more in the future!

notes.title: Waifu Drop Pool Changes
notes.notes:
We have added new Waifus that you can find on your journey! These new Waifus will replace the "Shy Waifu" and the "Waifu Bunnygirl" in the Waifu drop pool, meaning that these two will not drop anymore!

There was also an issue with the images of the new Waifus, where the image wasn't showing, but that should now be fixed.
